surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Off-white to light-grey median intensity across the primary dorsal surface.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse and soft-edged gradients between the grey pigmented regions and the off-white baseline.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: A prominent longitudinal dorsal ridge is visible along the posterior midline, casting a slight shadow that indicates topological elevation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A faint, elongated linear mark resembling a healed scratch is visible on the lower-left lateral dorsal surface.
